plan: A marksman who pokes from far with his projectiles and dodges everything with his teleport.
aSurveiller: His E (Arcane Shift). He teleports to dodge or finish a target: wait until he has used it before engaging him.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his Q stops on the first enemy hit.
Engage him right after his teleport (E): it takes a long time to come back.
Champions who close the gap quickly bother him: he deals little damage up close.
forces: Very hard to catch thanks to his teleport.
Pokes from far without taking risks.
His R crosses the whole map.
faiblesses: Low damage if he misses his projectiles.
Vulnerable once his teleport is used.

sorts.P: Gains attack speed when hitting with his spells.
sorts.Q: Projectile that lowers his cooldowns if it hits.
sorts.W: Orb that explodes when he hits the marked target.
sorts.E: Teleports and shoots the nearest enemy.
sorts.R: Huge beam that crosses the whole map.

momentFort: Steady all game, more dangerous in the mid game with his first items.
